title: v0.9.73 — Music for every adventure, growing with your cottage

blocks.text: Combat now has a faster, driving soundtrack, while the candy garden has a softer, relaxed tune. Picnic, pond and starlight activities each have their own melody and instruments. Music changes as you move between scenes, works offline, and respects mute and background pause.

New crops grow for 1×, 1.5×, 2× or 2.5× their base time at cottage levels 0, 1, 2 or 3. The planting preview shows the exact time. Crops already planted keep their deadlines and continue growing while the app is closed. Cooking and construction remain instant.

Please tell us whether the music fits each scene and stays comfortable during longer play. The Android test build is available from the fixed test-download link on the game page; this is not a Google Play or App Store release.
戰鬥現在有更明快、有節奏感的配樂，糖果庭院則使用柔和放鬆的旋律。野餐、池塘、星光活動各有不同旋律與配器，隨場景切換；離線可播，並遵守靜音與背景暫停設定。
新種作物依小屋Lv.0／1／2／3，使用基礎時間的1／1.5／2／2.5倍，種植前會顯示實際時間。已種作物保留原完成時間，關閉程式仍持續成長；料理與建設仍立即完成。
歡迎回報配樂是否符合各場景，以及長時間遊玩是否舒適。Android測試版可從遊戲頁的固定測試下載入口取得；這不是Google Play或App Store正式上架。
